scripts.deps:svg: mkdir -p .deps && npx dependency-cruiser src --include-only '^src' --output-type dot | dot -T svg > .deps/deps.svg && open .deps/deps.svg
scripts.deps:archi: mkdir -p .deps && npx dependency-cruiser src --include-only '^src' --output-type archi | dot -T svg > .deps/archi.svg && open .deps/archi.svg
scripts.deps:feature: f=${F:-plan}; mkdir -p .deps && npx dependency-cruiser src/features/$f --output-type mermaid > .deps/$f.mmd && echo wrote .deps/$f.mmd
scripts.test: npx tsx --test src/lib/chordKit/*.test.ts src/lib/looper/*.test.ts src/features/instruments/*/*.test.ts src/lib/improv/*.test.ts src/features/sound/engine/*.test.ts src/features/tuner/*.test.ts src/features/rhythm/*.test.ts src/features/theory/*.test.ts src/features/course/*.test.ts src/features/theory/piano/*.test.ts src/lib/practice/*.test.ts src/features/widgets/*.test.ts src/features/creator/model/*.test.ts src/features/sampler/*.test.ts src/features/sampler/model/*.test.ts src/features/sampler/server/*.test.ts src/features/nam/*.test.ts src/features/nam/server/*.test.ts src/features/earlyAccess/*.test.ts src/features/styles/*.test.ts src/features/stage/model/*.test.ts src/features/teachers/video/model/*.test.ts src/features/search/*.test.ts
